diagnosis.rootCause: getStudentClasses read the student-owned projection and then always performed a broad legacy classes scan; any scan error was caught by the outer function and converted to an empty list, discarding already-valid indexed summaries. sourceFix.behavior: When the student-owned projection exists, return its bounded, canonical-class-verified summaries without a broad classes scan. Retain the legacy scan only when the entire projection path is absent.
